name: Radix threshold ladder
rule: Use b^k boundaries as discrete scale events or shell indices.

name: Active-bit pulse simplex
rule: Embed sparse active positions as a chosen simplex or regular polygon while retaining bit positions as metadata.

name: Pascal parity mask
rule: Generate a Sierpinski occupancy mask with exact parity tests; do not claim generic power-of-two rows are all odd.

name: Dutch teen suffix hinge
rule: Represent morphological order separately from decimal place order.

name: Dutch en-order hinge
rule: Insert a connector node and perform a two-component semantic transposition.

name: Cut-open boundary graph
rule: Change a loop constraint into an open path with explicit endpoint identity.

name: Loop-to-leg morph
rule: Interpolate curve controls while separately recording the topology event.

name: Split-oval antisymmetry
rule: Use a fixed center node and opposite signed displacement fields.

name: Overlap-lens domain
rule: Treat overlap as geometry, tolerance, blend or join domain only after semantics are declared.

name: SDF-zero event
rule: Promote a boundary crossing from sampling detail to event semantics.

name: Cone support gate
rule: Prune by radial and angular support before relation solving.

name: Nested-shell relevance
rule: Use concentric intervals as local multiscale support, not global identity.

name: Mobius orientation wrap
pipeline: boundary crossing -> coordinate wrap + orientation flip
rule: Implement non-orientability as an explicit quotient map.

name: Klein sheet wrap
pipeline: boundary crossing -> wrap + orientation and sheet update
rule: Keep projected self-intersection distinct from state coupling.

name: Hourglass route table
rule: Route through a finite four-sector table.

name: Log-polar bitmask
pipeline: Cartesian point -> core flag, rho, theta -> sector bit
rule: Use a compact local admission mask with explicit dimensions and singular core.

name: Golden-angle schedule
rule: Use as a sample schedule only; no zero-aliasing or zero-cost claim.

name: Bounded grammar recursion
rule: Stop on depth, symbol, expression or cycle limits.

name: Event-latched field morph
rule: Keep visual interpolation and committed topology state separate.

name: Content-addressed definition graph
rule: Make the substrate carry and verify its own operator definitions.
